content: In the dependent PRs , i am facing build failures, like the proof given in the open PR is using other theorems/lemmas in the dependent PRs, how do i make sure that the dependent prs are build first then the current pr?
If PR x depends on PR y just merge the branch of y into the branch of x. GitHub does nothing about dependent PR, in practice you have to handle this by hand.
If it's just one or two PRs is totally doable.
